To answer your question, the team is rolling out parts of the game for the community to test, review, and give opinions on. This feedback loop let's the devs fix problems earlier and allow for the game to be worked on in small parts as opposed to a whole game being developed only for bugs to be found months or years after release.

The main game is separated unto parts, such as racing tracks in megadomes, custom domes, and themed zones. Additionally the themed zones are also broken down into Sectors. The team is currently developing the first sector of each of the first three themed zoned, with a projected number of 12 themed zones total for the final project. So later this year the first sector of each of the first three themed should be available for our community to test and interact with. There is also the Mega Dome Race Track that is scheduled to come out next quarter. We also have a mobile app in development and will have the second round of testing available for the community at some point this year as well. 

The way that the team has designed the game making process with their Agile workflow will help compartmentalize large objectives, and allow for the teams to build with high detail multiple avenues of development, and bring a MVP (minimum viable product) to market much sooner than most. 

Additionally I'd like to point out that the release of the game in its full P+E glory will not be out until all the variables have been accounted for. Cornucopia Card Game

Objective: Collect the most valuable cornucopia by the end of the game.

Number of players: 2-4

Duration: 5-10 minutes

Cards:

Cornucopia cards (different types of cornucopia with different values)
Action cards (cards that can be used to steal, trade or protect cornucopia cards)
Gameplay:

Each player starts with a set of cards (5-7) consisting of cornucopia and action cards.

Players take turns playing one card at a time.

On a player's turn, they can either play a cornucopia card or an action card. Cornucopia cards are placed face-up in front of the player, creating their collection. Action cards can be used to steal, trade or protect cornucopia cards from other players.

After a player plays a card, the next player takes their turn.
Players can also opt to pass their turn, instead of playing a card.

The game ends when all players have passed their turn or when a predetermined number of rounds have been played.
The player with the most valuable cornucopia collection wins the game.

Strategy:

Collect as many valuable cornucopia as possible
Use action cards to steal valuable cornucopia from other players or protect your own.

Trade cornucopia cards with other players to complete a valuable collection

Pay attention to other players' collections and try to anticipate their moves.

This game is a simple card game based on the theme of Cornucopia, and it allows players to compete head to head, include strategy but be easily picked up and it should not last long (edited)
